ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus) DLL side-loading via abused signed binary from non-standard path
ucs.description: Hunts APT32's signature DLL side-loading tradecraft: a small, recurring set of legitimately-signed binaries (Symantec RasTls, Avast wsc_proxy, Adobe AcroTranscoder, FlexNet, GoogleUpdate, Word's wwlib) is dropped to a user-writable directory and executed there so a hijacked DLL is loaded from the same folder. The image-path/parent-path mismatch is the high-fidelity tell — these binaries should never run outside Program Files.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("wsc_proxy.exe","rastls.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","flexnetauthservice.exe","googleupdate.exe","forti*.exe","wwlib.exe","sylib.exe","goopdate.exe","crashreporter.exe") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Downloads\\*") AND NOT (Processes.process_path="*\\Program Files\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Program Files (x86)\\*") by host Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.user _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_path as image | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// APT32/OceanLotus DLL side-loading: legit signed binary running from user-writable dir
let APT32_SideloadBins = dynamic(["wsc_proxy.exe","rastls.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","flexnetauthservice.exe","googleupdate.exe","wwlib.exe","sylib.exe","goopdate.exe","crashreporter.exe","fortiproxy.exe"]);
let SuspectPaths = dynamic([@"\Users\Public\",@"\AppData\Roaming\",@"\AppData\Local\Temp\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Downloads\"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName in~ (APT32_SideloadBins)
| where FolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths)
| where FolderPath !has @"\Program Files\" and FolderPath !has @"\Program Files (x86)\"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, LoadedDll = FileName, LoadedDllPath = FolderPath, LoadedDllSHA256 = SHA256, InitiatingProcessId
  ) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, LoadedDll, LoadedDllPath, LoadedDllSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT32/OceanLotus DLL side-loading on SecurityEvent 4688
let APT32_SideloadBins = dynamic([@"\wsc_proxy.exe",@"\rastls.exe",@"\acrotranscoder.exe",@"\flexnetauthservice.exe",@"\googleupdate.exe",@"\wwlib.exe",@"\sylib.exe",@"\goopdate.exe",@"\crashreporter.exe",@"\fortiproxy.exe"]);
let SuspectPaths = dynamic([@"\Users\Public\",@"\AppData\Roaming\",@"\AppData\Local\Temp\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Downloads\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any (APT32_SideloadBins)
| where NewProcessName has_any (SuspectPaths)
| where NewProcessName !has @"\Program Files\" and NewProcessName !has @"\Program Files (x86)\"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, ProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: APT32 OceanLotus DLL Side-Loading via Abused Signed Binary From Non-Standard Path
id: 5a3c7b2e-4d61-49f9-b8ad-2b4d6f9a32a1
status: experimental
description: Detects APT32/OceanLotus hallmark DLL side-loading — legitimately-signed third-party binaries (Symantec RasTls, Avast wsc_proxy, Adobe AcroTranscoder, FlexNet, GoogleUpdate, Word's wwlib) executing from user-writable directories instead of their canonical Program Files install path.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2018/03/13/oceanlotus-ships-new-backdoor/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\rastls.exe'
      - '\acrotranscoder.exe'
      - '\flexnetauthservice.exe'
      - '\googleupdate.exe'
      - '\wwlib.exe'
      - '\sylib.exe'
      - '\goopdate.exe'
      - '\crashreporter.exe'
      - '\fortiproxy.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Downloads\'
  filter_legit:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Program Files\'
      - '\Program Files (x86)\'
  condition: selection_image and selection_path and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Portable installer staging directories (rare, vendor-specific)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\\WSC_PROXY.EXE OR *\\rastls.exe OR *\\RasTls.exe OR *\\acrotranscoder.exe OR *\\AcroTranscoder.exe OR *\\flexnetauthservice.exe OR *\\FlexNetAuthService.exe OR *\\googleupdate.exe OR *\\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\\wwlib.exe OR *\\WWLIB.exe OR *\\sylib.exe OR *\\goopdate.exe OR *\\crashreporter.exe OR *\\fortiproxy.exe) AND @Image:(*\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Downloads\\*) AND NOT @Image:(*\\Program Files\\* OR *\\Program Files (x86)\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(wsc_proxy|rastls|acrotranscoder|flexnetauthservice|googleupdate|wwlib|sylib|goopdate|crashreporter|fortiproxy)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(Users\\\\Public|AppData|Temp|ProgramData|Downloads)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| sort(count, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 maldoc → mshta/wscript HTA staging chain (KerrDown / METALJACK lures)
ucs.description: Hunts APT32's spear-phishing initial-access chain in which a weaponised Office document (often a Vietnamese-language lure targeting dissidents, ASEAN diplomats, or auto-industry orgs) spawns mshta.exe or wscript.exe to fetch a remote HTA / encoded script that decodes a KerrDown or Cobalt Strike loader. T1204.002 → T1218.005 → T1059.001 is the actor's signature delivery-to-execute pivot.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process_id Processes.parent_process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(cmdline,"(?i)(http[s]?:\\/\\/|javascript:|vbscript:|scrobj\\.dll|-enc(odedcommand)?\\s|-nop|FromBase64String|IEX|Invoke-Expression|hidden|bypass|DownloadString)") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// APT32 maldoc -> mshta/wscript -> staging chain
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","eqnedt32.exe"]);
let LolBinChildren = dynamic(["mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","hh.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
| where FileName in~ (LolBinChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend SuspectMarkers = ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","javascript:","vbscript:","scrobj.dll","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-nop","FromBase64String","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-WindowStyle Hidden","-w hidden","-ExecutionPolicy Bypass","DownloadString",".hta")
| where SuspectMarkers == true or FileName =~ "mshta.exe"  // mshta from Office is suspicious regardless
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?)\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = iff(isnotempty(B64), base64_decode_tostring(B64), "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          Decoded, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT32 maldoc -> mshta/wscript chain on SecurityEvent 4688
let OfficeParents = dynamic([@"\winword.exe",@"\excel.exe",@"\powerpnt.exe",@"\outlook.exe",@"\eqnedt32.exe"]);
let LolBinChildren = dynamic([@"\mshta.exe",@"\wscript.exe",@"\cscript.exe",@"\rundll32.exe",@"\regsvr32.exe",@"\powershell.exe",@"\pwsh.exe",@"\hh.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any (OfficeParents)
| where NewProcessName has_any (LolBinChildren)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend SuspectMarkers = CommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","javascript:","vbscript:","scrobj.dll","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-nop","FromBase64String","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-WindowStyle Hidden","-w hidden","-ExecutionPolicy Bypass","DownloadString",".hta")
| where SuspectMarkers == true or NewProcessName has @"\mshta.exe"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: APT32 OceanLotus Maldoc Stager - Office Spawning Mshta/Wscript/PowerShell
id: 8f1ad4b5-7c93-4e88-9d2a-3b7e91c5d610
status: experimental
description: Detects APT32 spear-phishing initial-access chain - Office document (often Vietnamese-language lure) spawns mshta.exe / wscript.exe / powershell.exe to fetch a remote HTA or execute an obfuscated KerrDown / Cobalt Strike loader.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.fireeye.com/blog/threat-research/2017/05/cyber-espionage-apt32.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.initial-access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\eqnedt32.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\hh.exe'
  selection_markers:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - 'javascript:'
      - 'vbscript:'
      - 'scrobj.dll'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - '-nop'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'WindowStyle Hidden'
      - 'ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - '.hta'
  selection_mshta_only:
    Image|endswith: '\mshta.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and (selection_markers or selection_mshta_only)
falsepositives:
  - Internal macros that legitimately shell out (rare, should be allow-listed by signing cert)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\eqnedt32.exe) AND @Image:(*\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\hh.exe) AND (@CommandLine:(*http\:* OR *https\:* OR *javascript\:* OR *vbscript\:* OR *scrobj.dll* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *"-enc "* OR *-nop* OR *FromBase64String* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *"WindowStyle Hidden"* OR *"ExecutionPolicy Bypass"* OR *DownloadString* OR *.hta*) OR @Image:(*\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|eqnedt32)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|powershell|pwsh|hh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(https?:|javascript:|vbscript:|scrobj\\.dll|-EncodedCommand|-enc\\s|-nop|FromBase64String|IEX|Invoke-Expression|WindowStyle\\s+Hidden|ExecutionPolicy\\s+Bypass|DownloadString|\\.hta)", field=CommandLine, flags="i") OR ImageFileName=/\\mshta\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| sort(count, order=desc)
